pageTitle: cyYour notice proposing a new rent
questionTitle: cyDo you think the notice is legally valid?
validSection13: cyYour landlord must give you a valid section 13 notice before increasing your rent.
bullet1: cygive the correct notice period (at least 2 months)
bullet2: cynot increase the rent within 52 weeks of the last increase
bullet3: cystart the increase on the correct date
bullet4: cyinclude your correct details, such as your name and address
stillChallengeIncrease: cyYou can still challenge the rent increase even if the notice is valid.
mustStillSubmitApplication: cyIf you think the notice is not valid, you must still submit this market rent determination application.
